description: Beta distribution cumulative distribution function I_x(a, b) on [0, 1], including both tails and the ends of the support

tolerance.reason: Same function as betainc, so betainc's tolerance (accepted by the owner, to be revisited). The prefix x^a (1-x)^b / B(a, b) of the smaller of I and 1 - I is a product of factors whose logarithms (a ln x, b ln(1 - x), ln Gamma(a), ln Gamma(b), ln Gamma(a + b)) reach 1.78e5 in magnitude at a normal result on this grid (ln Gamma(2e4) at a = b = 1e4); rounding each to a double separately loses up to 1.78e5 * 2^-53 = 2.0e-11, while combining them before rounding (Boost's Lanczos-based prefix) does not, so 1e-12 demands the careful method. SciPy's worst error here is 1.1e-13 (a = b = 1000, x = 0.3), except 1.1e-9 at a = b = 1/2, x = 1 - 1e-15, where the closed form (2/pi) asin(sqrt x) confirms mpmath. The ends of the support give 0 and 1 exactly
